findingClass: a completed RHP/DRHP extraction leaves its IPO with no promoters or no listed peers, and nothing names why - every prospectus prints both, so an empty child table after a completed read is a reader that failed in silence
failThreshold: any COMPLETED RHP/DRHP document extracted on or after the wiring date whose IPO has 0 promoters rows, or 0 peer_companies rows without the E6 step evidence peerReason peer_comparison_issuer_states_no_listed_peers; each offender is named with its document id and the extractor's own peer reason
unverifiableWhen: no RHP/DRHP has completed extraction since the wiring date - the population is empty, which is a statement about the corpus and not about the pipeline
why: #545: staging 2026-09-26 had 91 COMPLETED RHP/DRHP documents, 59 on IPOs with 0 promoter rows and 89 on IPOs with 0 peer rows. The promoter reader was never called on the prospectus path, and the peer reader returned peer_comparison_table_found_but_no_peer_rows_parsed on every real RHP tried, through five separate mechanisms (table on the page after its heading, text-only table body, a letter-marker heading plus a KPI lookalike, no divider row, a missing highest/lowest summary nulling the list). Unit tests on real pages prove each reader reads; only an audit over real rows proves they are still being called and still yield.
locatorNote: Scoped to documents extracted on or after PROMOTER_PEER_WIRING_MERGED_AT (default 2026-09-26): documents completed earlier could not carry promoters or peers however healthy the pipeline is now, and are only re-read on their next extraction. Implemented in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs next to issuer_ratio_yield.
